integrity: Proof constructs every reachable state and separates all distinct states; standalone checks provide finite independent replay and are not treated as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to residue-output Moore machines counting scattered 010 or 101; does not determine minimal Boolean automata for fixed target residues. Earlier unindexed equivalent results and implicit consequences of inaccessible literature remain historical-priority risks.
title: Exact output-state complexity for modular alternating scattered triples
